title: Workshop Instructor — Python for Engineers
body: Sixty classmates who feared semicolons (good news: Python has none), eight weeks, zero loop-related casualties. Explaining a thing is the fastest way to find the holes in your own map of it — by week eight they navigated without me.

title: First light — AI Engineering at UNET
body: Astronomers call a telescope's first observation "first light". Mine was a linear-algebra lecture where I understood almost nothing and wanted, immediately, to understand all of it. I asked "what's a tensor?" out loud. Nobody laughed (much).
